ticker_news.title: Peter Thiel's Ties With JD Vance May Influence Palantir Co-Founder's Position On Trump Post VP Selection, Says Tech Investor - Benzinga
ticker_news.description: The selection of J.D. Vance as Donald Trump's running mate for the 2024 presidential election could potentially influence the stance of Palantir co-founder Peter Thiel towards Trump, given their close ties. This move could lead Thiel to reconsider his previous decision not to donate to Trump's campaign.
ticker_news.author: Benzinga Neuro, Benzinga Staff Writer
